Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for an IT Operations professional to support the monitoring, maintenance, and smooth operation of IT systems and services in a 24/7 environment.
 Responsibilites
 24/7 Surveillance & System Health:
Monitor global applications, cloud services, and data/content feeds using central monitoring consoles.
Identify performance issues or outages in real time and route network/hardware alerts to NOC or specialized teams.
 Content & Application Pipeline Validation
Verify real-time delivery of media, data feeds, and web portal services.
Troubleshoot ingestion delays, API/feed bottlenecks, and content availability issues.
 L2 Incident Support & Major Incident Response
Triage, investigate, and resolve L2 technical tickets in the ITSM tool within agreed SLA targets (MTTA / MTTR).
Act as the first responder for Major Incidents (SEV-1 / SEV-2); launch incident bridges, notify stakeholders, and coordinate with engineering teams and vendors.
 Identity & Access Management
Manage account provisioning, permissions, and security groups in Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Microsoft 365.
Assist users with remote access (VPN), MFA configurations, and application access.
 Operations Governance & Shift Continuity
Coordinate release and maintenance windows with business teams to avoid critical operational impact.
Conduct structured shift handovers to ensure zero-loss continuity for open incidents and maintenance tasks.
Maintain and update OCC runbooks and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
 Qualifications
 3+ years in IT support or help desk 
 Knowledge of AD, Azure, O365 
 Experience with remote access tools 
 Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., EasyVista) 
 Good communication and troubleshooting skills 
 Availability to work in shifts
